name: Brambles.ai: Affiliate AI Shopping Chatbot
author: Derek Brambles

sections.description:
Turn your publishing platform into a revenue engine with intelligent product recommendations that match what your visitors are reading about.

Brambles.ai uses artificial intelligence to analyze your published content and automatically display relevant products from top retailers. When visitors click and purchase, you earn affiliate commissions – completely hands-free monetization for publishers.

The Problem: Most affiliate monetization requires manual product placement, generic ads, or irrelevant recommendations that hurt user experience.

The Solution: Our affiliate AI chatbot pioneered conversational commerce for WordPress, using agentic commerce principles to create AI-powered shopping experiences that enhance rather than disrupt the reading experience.

Why Choose Brambles.ai?

✅ Zero Manual Work – AI automatically finds relevant products for every page
✅ Better User Experience – Contextual recommendations feel natural, not spammy
✅ Higher Conversion Rates – Relevant products convert better than generic ads
✅ Lightweight & Fast – Async loading won’t slow your WordPress site
✅ Built-in Payouts – Direct Stripe integration for commission payments
✅ Works on Any Niche – AI adapts to your content automatically

Perfect For Publishers:
– Content publishers who want to monetize with conversational commerce
– Digital publishers looking for AI-powered affiliate automation
– Niche publishers wanting agentic commerce integration
– Blog publishers seeking passive revenue through AI commerce
– Media publishers needing additional conversational monetization streams

MONETIZE YOUR CONTENT WITH AI

✅ AI Content Analysis – Automatically understands your page topics and content themes (agentic commerce)
✅ Contextual Product Matching – Shows relevant items from major retailers and affiliate networks
✅ Affiliate Revenue Tracking – Automatic commission attribution via Customer ID (CUID)
✅ Stripe Connect Payouts – Direct payments to your bank account with built-in processing
✅ Conversational Commerce – Interactive AI chatbot engages visitors in product discovery
✅ Multi-Retailer Network – Products from Amazon, major ecommerce platforms, and affiliate partners
✅ Automatic Optimization – AI learns and improves recommendations over time

DESIGN & PERFORMANCE

✅ Complete Customization – Colors, position, welcome messages, branding options
✅ Multi-language Support – English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Hebrew
✅ Mobile Optimized – Perfect responsive experience on all devices
✅ WordPress Integration – Native settings, shortcode support, theme compatibility
✅ Performance Optimized – CDN delivery, async loading, zero site speed impact

How It Works:
1. Install & Activate – Customer ID (CUID) generated automatically for revenue tracking
2. Connect Stripe – Set up direct payouts in Settings → Brambles.ai → Payouts
3. Customize Appearance – Choose colors, position, and welcome message
4. Start Earning – AI analyzes your content and shows relevant products automatically
5. Get Paid – Earn commissions when visitors click and purchase

Payouts: To receive commission payouts, connect your Stripe account in Settings → Brambles.ai → Payouts. Identity verification (KYC) may be required by Stripe before funds can be disbursed.

Third-Party Service:
This plugin connects to Brambles.ai for AI-powered product recommendations and affiliate revenue tracking. Revenue tracking uses your auto-generated Customer ID (CUID). Review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Stripe Connect required for payouts.

Comparison / Alternatives

Brambles.ai pioneered affiliate AI shopping chatbots for WordPress, combining conversational commerce with agentic shopping principles. Unlike traditional affiliate plugins, manual linking, or generic chatbots, this creates AI-powered shopping experiences that generate revenue through intelligent product discovery. If you’ve tried static affiliate links, basic chatbots, or manual product placement, Brambles.ai automates affiliate monetization through conversational AI shopping.

Works With

Works with popular WordPress setups including Classic Editor, Gutenberg, most themes, caching plugins, and page builders like Elementor. Can be used alongside WooCommerce or other ecommerce plugins to add contextual commerce to posts and pages without interfering with your store.

Privacy & Disclosures

This plugin processes limited data for affiliate attribution (Customer ID, page context, clicks). Publishers should add appropriate Privacy Policy language and affiliate disclosures.

Privacy Policy text provided in Settings → Brambles.ai → Privacy Help.

Terms: https://www.brambles.ai/terms-of-service
Privacy: https://www.brambles.ai/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
Quick Setup (2 minutes):

  1. Install and activate the plugin through WordPress admin
  2. Go to Settings → Brambles.ai to view your auto-generated Customer ID (CUID)
  3. Connect your Stripe account in Payouts section to receive commissions
  4. Customize appearance (colors, position, welcome message)
  5. The chatbot automatically appears and starts earning revenue

That’s it! The AI analyzes your content and shows relevant products immediately.
sections.faq:
How do I start earning affiliate revenue as a publisher?

Simply install and activate the plugin. Your Customer ID (CUID) is automatically created for publisher revenue tracking. To receive payouts, connect your Stripe account in Settings → Brambles.ai → Payouts. The AI will start showing relevant products on your published content immediately.

Do I need to manually add affiliate links?

No! That’s the beauty of Brambles.ai. The AI automatically analyzes your published content and shows relevant products without any manual work. Perfect for publishers who want to monetize without spending time on affiliate management.

How does the AI choose which products to show?

Our AI reads your page content (titles, text, images) and matches it with products from major retailers. If you’re writing about “coffee brewing,” it might show coffee makers, beans, or brewing accessories. The recommendations are contextual and relevant to what visitors are reading.

Will this slow down my WordPress site?

Absolutely not. The widget loads asynchronously from our global CDN and won’t block your page rendering. It’s designed to be lightweight and performance-optimized for WordPress.

What if I already have a Stripe account?

Perfect! You can connect your existing Stripe account through the plugin settings. The setup takes just a few clicks and enables direct commission payouts to your bank account.

Can I customize the widget appearance?

Yes! Go to Settings → Brambles.ai to customize:
– Primary and secondary colors to match your brand
– Position (bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, top-left)
– Custom welcome message
– Proactive engagement settings
– Auto-display on all pages (enabled by default)

Do I need to add affiliate disclosures?

We recommend including an affiliate disclosure on pages where products are shown (example: “We may earn a commission from qualifying purchases”). You can find suggested disclosure text in the plugin settings under Privacy Policy Help.

What languages are supported?

The widget automatically detects and supports multiple languages including English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, and Hebrew. Language switching is handled automatically by the AI.

Can I use this with WooCommerce or other ecommerce plugins?

Yes! Brambles.ai works alongside any existing ecommerce setup. It adds contextual product recommendations that complement your existing store without interfering with your current monetization.

How much can I earn?

Earnings depend on your traffic and content niche. AI optimization means higher conversion rates than generic ads. Monthly payments via Stripe Connect.
